sourceRefs.excerpt: PRODUCT SUMMARY − TM ATLAS WEALTH In this Product Summary, “ we, “ us ”, “ our ” refer to Tokio Marine Life Insurance Singapore Pte. Ltd. Plan Description TM Atlas Wealth is a whole life, limited premium investment-linke

Initial Charge During the premium payment term, an initial charge of 4% p.a. of the Initial Units Account value will be deducted monthly on each Policy Monthiversary* through deduction of units from the Initial Units Acc

sourceRefs.section: Appendix A Surrender Charge / MPC reference

notes: Models the published Monthly Protection Charge for the Advanced Death corridor during the 22-year premium payment term.
The first policy year Monthly Protection Charge is accrued and deducted from the Accumulation Units Account in one lump sum in the second policy year.
From the second policy year onward, Monthly Protection Charge is deducted monthly in advance from the Accumulation Units Account while the policy remains in force.
The sum at risk is the published net premium less 101% of policy value, using Initial plus Accumulation Units Account value for the valuation basis.

If the Accumulation Units Account cannot fully fund Monthly Protection Charge due, the death benefit is downgraded to Basic Death Benefit, future new Monthly Protection Charge stops, and the outstanding amount remains collectible as indebtedness.

catalogWarnings: TM Atlas Wealth is cataloged as a supported V1 product. The parser captures the published SGD premium-payment-term family from 5 to 25 years across Basic Death and Advanced Death corridors with executable regular-premium routing, grouped published initial bonus tiers by premium-payment-term band, annual loyalty bonus with the published bounded adjustment-factor formula during the premium payment term and the flat post-term rate thereafter, account-fee-rate modeling for the initial and policy charges, recurring single premium and top-up charges into the Accumulation Units Account, the after-first-policy-year regular-premium variation start gate with the published SGD minimum regular-premium table, the commencement-date recurring-single-premium resumption gate after premium holiday, the published surrender charge on the Initial Units Account, the nil-charge one-off partial-withdrawal path with the published second-policy-year accumulation-account gate, post-term Initial Units Account access, S$500 minimum withdrawal amount, and S$3,000 minimum account value, and the published phase-specific dividend cash-payout account restrictions through the manual distribution-mode assumption surface.
Dividend cash payouts are modeled through the manual distribution-mode assumption surface with the published SGD 50 minimum payout threshold and 30-day record-date lead time.

Recurring single premium stays blocked after a premium-holiday event until an explicit recurring-single-premium resumption is entered and the regular premium amount is restored to the commencement-date amount.
Minimum regular-premium increase / reduction amounts remain informational only because the summary leaves those insurer-defined.

Basic Death keeps Monthly Protection Charge metadata-only, while the Advanced Death variant models the published current death-benefit estimate, first-policy-year accrual, policy-year-2 settlement, policy-value valuation basis, irreversible downgrade after failed deduction, and static current multi-life last-life handling.

Premium-holiday lapse behavior, change-of-life-assured administration, regular withdrawal, selected-fund residual-value conditions, credit-card charge, and non-SGD corridors remain informational only.
Structured extraction validated against the TM Atlas Wealth product summary text layer.
This supported template models the SGD / premium-payment-term-22 (Advanced Death) corridor.

This supported template models 12-month initial-versus-accumulation routing, the published 20-to-24-year premium payment terms initial bonus tiers, the published initial charge and policy charge through executable account fee rates, recurring single premium and top-up routing into the Accumulation Units Account, the after-first-policy-year regular-premium variation start gate with the published SGD minimum regular-premium table, the published surrender charge on the Initial Units Account, and the phase-specific dividend cash-payout account restrictions through the manual distribution-mode assumption surface.

The Advanced Death variant also models the published current death-benefit estimate, first-policy-year Monthly Protection Charge accrual, policy-year-2 settlement, policy-value valuation basis, and irreversible downgrade to Basic Death after failed Accumulation Units Account deduction during the 22-year premium payment term.
Recurring single premium events before policy month 13 or below the published monthly-equivalent minimum of S$50 are blocked; insurer-defined increase / reduction minimums remain informational only.

Recurring single premium stays blocked during premium holiday until an explicit recurring-single-premium resumption is entered and the regular premium amount is restored to the committed commencement-date amount.
Minimum regular-premium increase / reduction amounts remain informational only because the summary leaves those insurer-defined.

This product supports distribution-paying fund elections. V1 seeds reinvest by default; cash payout requires a manual annual distribution-yield assumption, and payouts below the published minimum annual cash-payout amount of S$50 remain reinvested.
Cash payout elections for dividend-paying funds should be submitted at least 30 days before the record date.

Advanced Death payout handling beyond the modeled current death-benefit estimate and Monthly Protection Charge, change-of-life-assured administration, premium-holiday lapse behavior, regular withdrawal, credit-card charge, and non-SGD corridors remain metadata-only.
